payload.core_mechanism_summary: DP array dp[i] stores moves from room i to i+1; recurrence sums dp[p_i..i-1] + 2; final answer sum of dp[1..n] mod 1e9+7.
payload.rationale: Solution uses 1D DP array with state defined per room, iterative bottom-up computation with range sum, matching dp_1d_state. No 2D or tree structures. Typical for such problem where state depends on prefix.
